title: Adaptive Onboarding Hero System + Screenshot Automation for Quickstart
creator: Aisha Kaur
description:
Goal: Ship a modular, device-aware hero system for the Quickstart landing that scales across product variants and automates production screenshots for docs/releases. This ticket covers visual system tokens, component states (empty, starter, advanced), motion-reduced variants, and a CI-driven screenshot pipeline that captures desktop/tablet/phone breakpoints and feature-flag permutations. The deliverable is a Figma component library set, a screenshot generator script + pipeline config, and a design QA checklist for engineering handoff.

Why this is different: existing quickstart visuals are static hero images and ad-hoc screenshots. This work creates a single source of truth: composable components in Figma linked to automated screenshot outputs that feed the docs site and release changelog. It reduces drift between product state and marketing assets and significantly reduces release overhead for PMs and Docs.

Scope:
- Finalize hero composition rules (layout grid, left-anchored content, side visual token library).
- Define three canonical hero states and responsive scaling behaviors.
- Implement motion-reduced transition guidelines (prefers-reduced-motion).
- Produce a Figma library with export presets and naming conventions for automation.
- Build a lightweight Node.js screenshot generator + Playwright config that runs in CI and deposits artifacts to GCS/Drive.
- Provide design tokens and CSS variables for implementation parity.

Out of scope: full page redesign, localization copy rewrites beyond short strings, automated A/B testing infra (handed to Eng/PM as follow-up).
